Ears are relatively short and rounded compared to kangaroos. Pouch opens anteriorly. Body exhibits bilateral symmetry with digitigrade hind foot posture. Weight ranges 1-25 kg depending on species. objects.taxonomy_description: Stocky tailless marsupial measuring 60-85 cm in body length with robust rounded body form. Fur is dense, woolly, and grey-brown with distinctive white patches on chest, ears, and rump. Ears are large, rounded, and prominently furry with white marginal tufts. Nose is broad, leathery, and black with distinctive textured surface. Limbs are powerful with five digits each; forefeet feature two opposable thumbs for gripping eucalyptus branches. Claws are sharp and curved for climbing. Body exhibits stocky proportions with broad chest and rounded abdomen. Head is broad with small eyes and inconspicuous ears relative to body size. Weight ranges 4-15 kg with sexual dimorphism. Posture is typically upright when seated on branches.
